About Northline

Not a franchise. Not a call center. Just a family that's been doing honest plumbing and heating work in Grand Rapids for 37+ years.

Our Story

Started by One Man
With One Truck

Walt Holstrom grew up in Grand Rapids, apprenticed under his uncle's plumbing shop in the 1970s, and earned his journeyman license in 1979. By 1987, he had enough saved to go out on his own. He bought a used truck, printed some business cards, and started knocking on doors.

Word spread the way it does in tight-knit neighborhoods: someone would call, Walt would show up on time, do the job right, charge what he'd quoted, and leave the place clean. That neighbor would tell a neighbor. Thirty-seven years later, we have four trucks on the road and a waiting list on non-emergency calls.

Walt's son Dave grew up riding along on jobs in middle school and earned his own license in 2003. He and his wife Karen officially took over day-to-day operations in 2011. Walt still comes in a few times a week — says he can't stay away.

We're not going to tell you we're the biggest plumbing company in Grand Rapids. We're not. But we'd argue we're the most consistent: same faces, same standards, same phone number since the beginning.

Our History

1987
Northline Founded

Walt Holstrom launches Northline with a single truck and a reputation for reliability built over 8 years at another shop.

1994
Second Truck on the Road

Growing demand leads to the first hire beyond Walt himself. Northline adds a second licensed journeyman and a second truck.

2003
Dave Earns His License

After apprenticing through high school and college, Walt's son Dave Holstrom earns his Michigan plumbing contractor license and joins full-time.

2008
HVAC License Added

Northline expands into heating system work, adding boiler service and gas line work to the offering. The HVAC contractor license is issued.

2011
Second Generation Takes Over

Dave and Karen Holstrom step into ownership. Walt remains a part-time presence and advisor.

Today
Four Trucks, Same Values

Still family-run, still same-day emergency service, still answering our own phone. 5,200+ jobs completed across Greater Grand Rapids.

“

Treat every customer like a neighbor, not a ticket number. Show up when you say you will. Charge what you quoted. Leave it cleaner than you found it.

— Walt Holstrom, Founder · Still on the job since 1987

Why We're Different

The Way We Work

These aren't marketing bullets. They're things we actually do on every job, every time.

Upfront Written Estimates

We give you a written estimate before work starts. The price we quote is the price you pay — no scope creep without discussion and your approval first.

We Show Up on Time

We give you a 2-hour arrival window and call when we're 30 minutes out. If something changes, we call you — not vice versa.

Background-Checked Technicians

Everyone who enters your home passes a background check. They wear uniforms, drive marked trucks, and carry ID. No surprises at the door.

Quality Parts, 1-Year Warranty

We use quality parts, not the cheapest thing in the supply house. Every repair carries a 1-year labor warranty. Equipment warranties as applicable.

We Respect Your Home

Shoe covers on, drop cloths down, work area cleaned up before we leave. We're guests in your home and we act like it.

No Upselling

We fix what's broken and tell you honestly if something else is worth addressing. We won't push a $4,000 water softener on a service call for a leaky faucet.
